messages:
gina: rolling out mtls-strict profile to ap-south nonprod at 03:40 UTC. canaries failing with TLS alert: handshake_failure.

omar: which part of the profile? we tightened cipher suites and set min TLS 1.3 only.

gina: correct. also enabled "client_cert_require": true for the ingress filter. canary logs show client cert validation failed.

lisa: paste ingress log?

ops-oncall: ```
[2026-05-11T03:41:12Z] ingress ERROR TLS verify failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (possibly missing intermediate)
[2026-05-11T03:41:12Z] ingress WARN presented_cert_chain_len=1 expected_chain_len=3
```

omar: hmm that suggests the client (service-canary) is presenting only leaf cert; it relied on the keystore loader to attach intermediates. did keystore rotation happen?

gina: we rotated leaf certs yesterday and updated signing chain, but I remember a secrets job to rewrap keys using KMS/hsm last night.

secrets-bot: secret-rewrap job completed: rewrap-keystore-ap-south-20260510 by lisa — step 3/3.

lisa: checking KMS logs: there are Deny entries for Decrypt on the secret ARN at 02:58 UTC for principal arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/keystore-loader-sa/apiserver. Role binding for keystore-loader SA was modified in cluster-rbac change 02:30 — might be related.

ops-oncall: CloudTrail snippet: `2026-05-11T02:58:01Z KMS Decrypt AccessDenied for principal assumed-role/keystore-loader-sa`

omar: if keystore-loader couldn't decrypt the EDK, it may have written an incomplete keystore object (missing intermediates) to the local store. ingress then sees only leaf cert.

gina: mitigation: revert RBAC binding for keystore-loader SA or temporarily add kms:Decrypt to its assumed role in the key policy. which is less risky?

lisa: revert RBAC binding is minimal blast. doing rollback now.

ops-oncall: rollback applied at 03:48 UTC. keystore-loader reprocessed objects and fetched full chain at 03:52. ingress canaries started succeeding at 03:54.

gina: follow-ups: 1) CI test to validate full cert chain is loaded after rotations (owner: devex), 2) update rotation playbook to validate KMS Decrypt for loader role before promoting (owner: infra), 3) consider using assume-role pattern so loader never requires direct keypolicy grants (owner: security).

sec-bot: incident created INC-20260511-3 by gina. priority=P2. linked playbook: mtls-profile-enforce-checklist-v1

lisa: also adding alert: if ingress reports presented_cert_chain_len < expected for any SNI >5/sec -> page.

gina: thanks team. marking resolved for now :white_check_mark:
